resources.string: Lower resolution or FPS during sustained congestion, slow decoding or heat, then recover gradually. Uses automatic bitrate when supported. Requires host reconfiguration support and an adaptive decoder; unavailable with PyroWave.
Smallest short edge, preserving the aspect ratio. The selected stream resolution remains the maximum. A lower starting resolution is never increased by this limit.
Lowest allowed FPS. The selected stream frame rate remains the maximum. Applies to automatic quality, including battery mode.

Saved for this PC. Motion lowers resolution first; Detail lowers FPS first. Battery gradually limits work to at most 60 FPS and a 1080-pixel short edge, within your minimum limits. Codec, HDR and the display choice stay as negotiated.
Automatic quality is off: this PC or device can’t change resolution and frame rate during a stream.
Automatic quality stopped: the PC didn’t apply the new size. The stream goes on; pick another mode in the stream menu.
